name: Tiara
definition: jewelled ornamental half-circlet worn on the head, open at the back.

name: Crown
definition: closed or full-circle ornamental headpiece worn as jewellery, not as regalia of an office.

name: Maang tikka
definition: ornament hung on a chain along the hair parting with a pendant resting on the forehead.

name: Hairpin
definition: decorative pin or stick pushed into the hair to hold or adorn it (kanzashi-type pins included).

name: Decorative hair clip
definition: jewelled or ornamental clip, comb or slide fixed into the hair (a plain functional clip is H1).

name: Stud earring
definition: earring whose ornament sits on the lobe, held by a post and back.

name: Hoop earring
definition: earring formed as a circle or part-circle of metal through the lobe.

name: Drop earring
definition: earring whose ornament hangs below the lobe, still or swinging.

name: Jhumka
definition: bell- or dome-shaped hanging earring, often with a fringe of small beads.

name: Ear cuff
definition: piece that clips or wraps round the outer ear, usually without a piercing.

name: Ear climber
definition: earring that runs up the edge of the ear from a lobe post.

name: Straight barbell
definition: straight bar with an end at each side, for tongue, cartilage, nipple and similar piercings.

name: Curved barbell
definition: bent bar with an end at each side, for brow, rook, daith and similar piercings.

name: Captive bead ring
definition: ring held closed by a bead or ball captured between its ends by tension.

name: Labret stud
definition: post with a flat disc back inside and a decorative end outside, for lip and cartilage piercings.

name: Nose stud (nose pin, nosepin)
definition: small stud worn in a nostril piercing on an L-shape, screw, pin or bone post.

name: Nose ring
definition: ring or hoop worn through a nostril or septum piercing.

name: Navel curve
definition: curved barbell made for a navel piercing, usually with a larger or dangling lower end.

name: Plug
definition: solid cylinder worn in a stretched piercing (double, single or no flare).

name: Tunnel
definition: hollow cylinder worn in a stretched piercing.

name: Taper
definition: tapered spike or crescent used to stretch a piercing or worn as ornament.

name: Beaded necklace
definition: necklace of beads strung together, of glass, stone, wood or other material.

name: Collar necklace
definition: flat, wide necklace that lies round the base of the neck and over the collarbone.

name: Pearl necklace
definition: strand of pearls worn as a necklace.

name: Choker
definition: necklace that fits closely round the neck.

name: Lariat
definition: long necklace without a clasp, worn looped, knotted or threaded through itself.

name: Neck ring (torque)
definition: rigid ring of metal worn round the neck, open or closed.

name: Mangalsutra
definition: marriage necklace of black beads on a gold chain, usually with a pendant.

name: Chain
definition: linked metal chain worn on its own as a necklace (the link pattern is an attribute).

name: Pendant
definition: ornament hung from a bail on a chain or cord, sold on its own or with its chain.

name: Locket
definition: pendant that opens to hold a picture or keepsake.

name: Charm
definition: small ornament made to hang from a bracelet, chain or pendant loop.

name: Chain bracelet
definition: bracelet of linked chain.

name: Tennis bracelet
definition: flexible line of evenly set stones round the wrist.

name: Charm bracelet
definition: bracelet made to carry hanging or threaded charms.

name: Cuff bracelet
definition: rigid bracelet with an opening, slipped on over the side of the wrist.

name: Beaded bracelet
definition: bracelet of strung beads or stones, stretch or clasped (power-stone bracelets included).

name: Bangle
definition: rigid bracelet, closed or hinged, worn round the wrist (whatever a maker calls it).

name: Armlet
definition: band or ornament worn round the upper arm.

name: Band ring
definition: ring of uniform band, plain or set, without a raised head (wedding bands included).

name: Solitaire ring
definition: ring set with a single prominent stone (engagement solitaires included).

name: Signet ring
definition: ring with a flat face for an engraved crest, monogram or seal.

name: Stackable ring
definition: slim ring made to be worn in a stack with others.

name: Thumb ring
definition: ring made to be worn on the thumb.

name: Hand harness [haath phool]
definition: ornament joining one or more finger rings by chains to a bracelet across the back of the hand.

name: Brooch
definition: decorative ornament fixed to clothing by a hinged pin and catch.

name: Lapel pin
definition: small pin with a post and clutch worn in a jacket lapel.

name: Pin badge
definition: small badge, usually enamelled metal, pinned on as ornament (an identity badge is F5).

name: Patch
definition: embroidered or woven patch sewn or ironed on as ornament.

name: Cufflink
definition: ornament that fastens a shirt cuff through its buttonholes.

name: Tie clip
definition: bar or clip that holds a tie to the shirt (tie bars and tie pins included).

name: Waist chain (belly chain)
definition: chain or ornament worn round the waist or hips.

name: Anklet
definition: chain or band worn round the ankle.

name: Toe ring
definition: ring made to be worn on a toe.

name: Earring back
definition: replacement back or stopper made for an earring post.

name: Chain extender
definition: short chain with a clasp made to lengthen a necklace or bracelet.

name: Ring guard or sizer
definition: insert or band fitted to a ring to make it smaller or keep it in place.
